query:
SELECT
                         COUNT(*) AS "total!: i64",
                         COALESCE(SUM(s.user_id = ?), 0) AS "by_user!: i64"
                       FROM rsvp_sessions s
                       WHERE s.coupon_id = ?1 AND s.id != ?3
                         AND s.status NOT IN ('refund_pending', 'refund_confirmed')
